correctness.rationale: For any existing finite projective plane q>=2, the incidence B satisfies BB^T=qI+J, yielding four powered graph-distance eigenvalues: on constants q(q+1)2^a+(q+1)+q²3^a, bipartition q(q+1)2^a-(q+1)-q²3^a, and -2^a ±sqrt(q)(3^a-1), each last with multiplicity v-1. The bipartition and minus branches are strictly negative on the zero-sum space; the plus branch crosses once when sqrt(q)(3^beta-1)=2^beta. Schoenberg centered Gram has rank 2v-1 below and v at beta, and is indefinite above. Separate direct PG(2,2),PG(2,3) distance/eigenspectrum checks matched the threshold and critical rank. Proof applies to every finite projective plane by axioms, not extrapolation.
